# Data Dictionary — Synthetic Credit Bureau Feed

**Source System:** External Credit Bureau API Extract (simulates Equifax / Illion feed)  
**File:** Generated by `08_withheld_source/01_generate_bureau_feed.py`  
**Delimiter:** Comma (`,`)  
**Header Row:** Yes  
**Encoding:** UTF-8  
**Grain:** One row per customer per bureau refresh date  

> ⚠️ **WITHHELD SOURCE — DO NOT LOAD DURING INITIAL SETUP**
>
> This file is introduced in **Act 2 of the demo** (Scenario 2: New Source Onboarding).
> It is documented here so the mapping agent has a data dictionary to read, but the
> data and staging tables should NOT be loaded until the demo reaches that scenario.
> See `08_withheld_source/README.md` for demo facilitation instructions.

## Overview

The credit bureau feed represents a periodic refresh of external credit data
from a bureau provider. Large banks receive these feeds to:
- Refresh risk scores for existing customers (fraud and churn early warning)
- Validate declared income and liabilities at origination
- Monitor portfolio-level credit quality trends

This file is the withheld demo source because it **enriches existing domain entities**
(Customer and Loan) rather than introducing new entity types — making it the ideal
vehicle for the "new source into a mature model" mapping scenario.

The column naming conventions are deliberately bureaucratic and abbreviated, as is
common in credit bureau extracts, creating a realistic mapping challenge for the agent.

## Columns

| Column Name | Type | Nullable | Description |
|-------------|------|----------|-------------|
| BUREAU_RECORD_ID | VARCHAR(30) | N | Unique record identifier for this bureau response. Format: BUR-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXXXX. |
| CUSTOMER_ID | VARCHAR(20) | N | Bank customer identifier. Foreign key to Borrower Profile CUSTOMER_ID. |
| BUREAU_ENQUIRY_DATE | DATE | N | Date the bureau file was generated/requested. |
| BUREAU_PROVIDER_CODE | CHAR(3) | N | Bureau provider. EQX=Equifax, ILL=Illion, EXP=Experian. |
| CRED_SCORE_CURR | INTEGER | Y | Current credit score from the bureau. Range 0–1200 (Equifax scale). |
| CRED_SCORE_PREV | INTEGER | Y | Credit score from the previous bureau refresh. |
| CRED_SCORE_CHG | INTEGER | Y | Change in credit score since previous refresh. Negative = deterioration. |
| CRED_SCORE_BAND | CHAR(2) | Y | Score band classification. EX=Excellent (833+), VG=Very Good (726–832), GD=Good (622–725), AV=Average (510–621), BW=Below Average (<510). |
| FILE_AGE_MONTHS | INTEGER | Y | Age of the credit file in months (time since first credit event on file). |
| ENQ_3M | INTEGER | Y | Number of credit enquiries in the past 3 months. High values can indicate financial stress or fraud. |
| ENQ_6M | INTEGER | Y | Number of credit enquiries in the past 6 months. |
| ENQ_12M | INTEGER | Y | Number of credit enquiries in the past 12 months. |
| ENQ_MORTGAGE_3M | INTEGER | Y | Number of mortgage-specific enquiries in the past 3 months. |
| TOTAL_ACCOUNTS | INTEGER | Y | Total number of credit accounts on file (open and closed). |
| OPEN_ACCOUNTS | INTEGER | Y | Number of currently open/active credit accounts. |
| CREDIT_LIMIT_TOTAL | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Total credit limit across all open revolving accounts (credit cards, LOC). |
| CREDIT_BALANCE_TOTAL | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Total outstanding balance across all open credit accounts. |
| CREDIT_UTIL_RATIO | DECIMAL(5,4) | Y | Credit utilisation ratio — CREDIT_BALANCE_TOTAL / CREDIT_LIMIT_TOTAL. Range 0.0000–1.0000. |
| MORTGAGE_BALANCE_TOTAL | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Total outstanding mortgage balances reported to bureau. |
| NUM_DEFAULTS | INTEGER | Y | Number of recorded credit defaults on file. |
| DEFAULT_AMT_TOTAL | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Total dollar value of all defaults on file. |
| NUM_JUDGEMENTS | INTEGER | Y | Number of court judgements recorded on file. |
| JUDGEMENT_AMT_TOTAL | DECIMAL(15,2) | Y | Total dollar value of court judgements. |
| BANKRUPTCY_FLAG | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Bankruptcy recorded on file, N=No bankruptcy. |
| BANKRUPTCY_DATE | DATE | Y | Date of bankruptcy filing. Null if BANKRUPTCY_FLAG = 'N'. |
| PART_IX_FLAG | CHAR(1) | N | Y=Part IX debt agreement recorded, N=None. (Australian insolvency instrument.) |
| SERIOUS_CREDIT_IMPAIRMENT | CHAR(1) | N | Y=One or more serious credit impairments on file (default, judgement, bankruptcy), N=None. |
| REPMT_HIST_SCORE | INTEGER | Y | Repayment history score. 0–100. Higher = more consistent repayment history. Bureau-specific metric. |
| DEROG_MARKS | INTEGER | Y | Total number of derogatory marks on file (defaults + judgements + adverse payment history). |
| CREDIT_ACTIVE_SINCE | DATE | Y | Date of first credit event on file — proxy for credit history length. |
| BUREAU_REFRESH_DATE | DATE | N | Date this bureau record was loaded into the bank's systems. |
| DATA_SUPPLIER_CODE | CHAR(10) | Y | Internal code identifying the data feed contract/supplier arrangement. |

## Key Business Rules

- `CUSTOMER_ID` is the join key back to the Customer domain entity (via Borrower Profile)
- `CRED_SCORE_CHG` < -50 in a single period is a significant fraud/stress signal
- `ENQ_3M` > 5 combined with high `DEROG_MARKS` is a strong fraud indicator
- `SERIOUS_CREDIT_IMPAIRMENT = 'Y'` typically triggers a mandatory review process under APRA guidelines
- The bureau scale (0–1200) is the **Equifax Scale** — different from the US FICO scale (300–850) in the origination file; the mapping agent must note this semantic difference
- `REPMT_HIST_SCORE` is proprietary to the bureau — it cannot be directly compared across bureau providers

## Domain Model Enrichment (target of mapping exercise)

When introduced, this source **enriches** the following existing domain entities:

| Source Column(s) | Enriches Entity | Attribute(s) |
|-----------------|-----------------|--------------|
| CRED_SCORE_CURR, CRED_SCORE_BAND | Customer | bureau_credit_score, bureau_score_band |
| CRED_SCORE_CHG | CustomerInsight | credit_score_movement |
| SERIOUS_CREDIT_IMPAIRMENT, NUM_DEFAULTS | CustomerCompliance | credit_impairment_flag |
| BANKRUPTCY_FLAG, PART_IX_FLAG | CustomerCompliance | insolvency_flag |
| CREDIT_UTIL_RATIO, REPMT_HIST_SCORE | CustomerInsight | bureau_risk_indicators |
| ENQ_3M, ENQ_MORTGAGE_3M | LoanRisk (new attribute) | recent_enquiry_count |
| MORTGAGE_BALANCE_TOTAL | Loan | total_declared_mortgage_exposure |

> Note: All mappings above are *proposed* — producing and validating this mapping table
> is the core task of the demo's Act 2. The agent generates these; Sarah confirms them.
